method.definition: Deterministic typed JSON node/edge projection of recorded research artifacts; token-AND text search and bounded breadth-first relationship traversal.
method.purpose: Recover evidence and research behind successful, failed, open and superseded records without requiring chat history.
method.assumptions_and_limits: Existing records are authoritative only within their recorded scope. Graph links do not prove scientific claims or supply missing raw evidence. No PROV serialization/conformance claim, graph database or learned inference is used.
method.verification: Deterministic rebuild, unique IDs, typed attributed edges, endpoint resolution, source freshness, all18 gates, positive and negative outcomes, query/traversal and cycle/error tests. Software checks only; no scientific gate promotion.

sources.title: W3C PROV Overview (Working Group Note, 30 April 2013) and PROV Model Primer
sources.use: Conceptual distinction between entities/artifacts, activities and provenance relationships; motivation for explicit attribution. Project relationship vocabulary is custom.
sources.verification: Official overview/primer descriptions checked; no PROV compliance or imported scientific theorem claim.
